The paper in the desk tray and the whiteboard behind Indio both carry rows of fake glyphs.
The still is two stacked panels: a ship at sea above, men in white suits on a deck below.
Split into two panels (a lit window above, the man in a red headband below), with '1898' written on the doorframe.
The walls of the Hong Kong room are covered in posters and a scroll with fake glyphs.
